reports.imageAlt: A baker arranging freshly baked rolls at a sunlit bakery counter

text.text: What we look for in an operator.
Strong candidates bring restaurant leadership, financial readiness, and an ownership mindset that protects the product, team, and guest experience.
Relevant leadership may include multi-unit or high-volume restaurant operations.
Have the resources to develop responsibly.
Financial qualifications are discussed during the mutual evaluation process.
Protect the product. Lead the team. Serve the community.
Lead teams while upholding Budda's standards and community responsibilities.
✓A distinctive signature product✓Bakery and product standards
Meeting preliminary criteria does not constitute approval. An inquiry is not an application, territory reservation, or offer of a franchise.
Opens the Mutual Operator Fit section of the franchise opportunity.
